title: KILLA – Watermelon
description:
Killa Dry Watermelon just an awesome product with the taste of fresh watermelon.

It guarantees a tropical buzz and a slightly dry, pleasant aftertaste.

One of the Killa family’s most unique nicotine pouches

Portion size: 0,7g
Nicotine: 16 mg/1gram
Nicotine per portion: 11.2 mg
Portions per can: 20 pc.
